versions.changelog:
Initial release of quark-backup:

- Automatically or manually backs up the `.openclaw` directory to Quark Netdisk, excluding `node_modules` and browser cache.
- Supports scheduled daily automatic backups at 04:00 via cron, or one-time backups on demand.
- Uploads compressed backups to a dedicated `/openclaw/` folder on Quark Netdisk and verifies upload success.
- Requires Quark Netdisk Cookie for authentication; instructions provided for configuration.
- Includes instructions for local backup retention and full restore procedure.
